meta.name: explore-code
meta.description: Rigor Improve implementation leaf skill for auditable candidate implementation in deep learning research repositories. Use when the researcher explicitly authorizes exploratory work on an isolated branch or worktree to transplant modules, adapt a backbone, add LoRA or adapter layers, replace a head, or stitch together meaningful low-risk migration ideas with rollback-aware records in `explore_outputs/`. Do not use for end-to-end exploration orchestration on top of `current_research`, trusted baseline reproduction, conservative debugging, environment setup, verified contribution claims, or default repository analysis.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在深度学习仓库中安全地移植模块、添加适配层或LoRA层
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在研究代码库中做低风险的结构调整并保留回滚记录
copy.tagline_en: Safely transplant modules, adapt backbones, or add LoRA layers in deep learning repos
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to make low-risk structural changes in research codebases with rollback records

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会在你授权时，在独立分支上修改深度学习代码，比如移植模块、调整骨干网络、添加 LoRA 层或替换输出头，并记录修改原因和回滚方法。
howto.when: 当你明确要求 Claude 在隔离分支上做探索性代码修改（如模块移植、骨干适配、添加 LoRA 层等）时触发。

say.text: 帮我在这个仓库的隔离分支上移植一个注意力模块。
say.note: Claude 会创建分支并记录修改。

say.text: 给这个模型添加 LoRA 层，并记录回滚方法。
say.note: Claude 会插入 LoRA 层并生成回滚记录。

howto.what_en: When authorized, Claude modifies deep learning code on an isolated branch, e.g., transplanting modules, adapting backbones, adding LoRA layers, or replacing heads, and records why and how to roll back.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you explicitly ask Claude to make exploratory code changes on an isolated branch, such as module transplant, backbone adaptation, or LoRA insertion.

say_en.text: Transplant an attention module on an isolated branch in this repo.
say_en.note: Claude creates a branch and records changes.

say_en.text: Add LoRA layers to this model and document rollback steps.
say_en.note: Claude inserts LoRA layers and generates rollback records.
